contents.name: Ch. I §3.C, printed pp. 23–25: complex differential forms of bidegree (p,q), the splitting d = d' + d'' and the identities d'^2 = d''^2 = 0, d'd'' + d''d' = 0
Ch. I §11, printed p. 267: Definition (11.1) of a holomorphic vector bundle through holomorphic trivializations and holomorphic transition matrices
Ch. I §10–§11, printed pp. 266–268: (0,1)-connections (10.1)–(10.2), the canonical d''-connection (11.3) on a holomorphic bundle, d''^2 = 0 and the Dolbeault complex C^{infty}_{p,q}(X,E)

Ch. VI §1, printed pp. 288–289: proof of Definition (1.5): existence, uniqueness and local formula of the formal adjoint by integration by parts against the density

Ch. VI §2, printed pp. 289–290: (2.1) Sobolev lemma, (2.2) Rellich lemma, (2.3) Garding inequality and Corollary (2.4) (finite-dimensional kernel, closed range and the orthogonal decomposition L2 = P(C^infty) + ker P*)
Ch. VI §3.3, printed pp. 294–295: (3.15)–(3.16) the orthogonal decomposition of forms into harmonic, exact and coexact parts and (3.17) the de Rham Hodge isomorphism
Ch. VI §7.1, printed pp. 309–310: (7.1)–(7.2) the Dolbeault decomposition on a compact Hermitian manifold and its identification of harmonic (p,q)-forms as representatives
